Based on your experience at the AP®
Reading with student responses, what advice would you offer
teachers to help them improve the student performance on the exam?
• Teachers could repeatedly remind students of the importance of understanding and properly using standard
mathematical notation rather than creating new notation to communicate their ideas.
• Teachers could ask students to write specific integrands using defined functions and limits rather than relying on
rote formula expressions.
• Teachers could model precise and accurate communication, never displaying linkage errors or equating a variable
expression to a constant value.
• Teachers could have students practice using a calculator to solve an equation (without using the TRACE
function).
